why: Division and multiplication have the same rank: go left to right. 24 ÷ 4 = 6, then 6 × 2 = 12.
The power applies to 3 first: 3² = 9, then the minus: −9. (−3)² would be 9.
A fraction bar works like brackets: 18/3 = 6.

q: Revenue is 10 × 50, fixed cost 100 and variable cost 4 per unit for 50 units. Which expression gives profit?
why: All of the cost must be subtracted, so it goes in brackets: 500 − 300 = 200.
